title: Where shall we eat?
instructions: Ella ve Max akşam yemeği için yer seçiyor. Uzun bir diyalog; önerileri ve neden reddedildiklerini takip et.

script.speaker: ella
script.text: I'm hungry. Where shall we eat tonight?

script.speaker: max
script.text: What about the Chinese restaurant on Bridge Street?

script.speaker: ella
script.text: We went there last Friday. Let's try something different.

script.speaker: max
script.text: OK. There's a new Mexican place near the cinema. My sister says it's very good.

script.speaker: ella
script.text: Mexican food is too spicy for me. I can't eat hot food.

script.speaker: max
script.text: Hmm. What about the Italian restaurant in the old town? They make great pizza.

script.speaker: ella
script.text: I love pizza, but isn't it expensive?

script.speaker: max
script.text: It's not cheap, but on Tuesdays all pizzas are half price.

script.speaker: ella
script.text: Today is Tuesday! Perfect. Do we need to book a table?

script.speaker: max
script.text: Yes, it's always busy. I'll call them now. Is eight o'clock OK?

script.speaker: ella
script.text: Eight is a bit late. Can we go at half past seven?

script.speaker: max
script.text: Sure. Half past seven it is.

questions.prompt: Why doesn't Ella want Chinese food?
questions.feedback: Geçen cuma oraya gitmişler, farklı bir şey denemek istiyor.

questions.prompt: What is the problem with the Mexican restaurant?
options: The food is too spicy for Ella.
questions.feedback: Meksika yemeği Ella için fazla acı (too spicy).
questions.evidence: Mexican food is too spicy for me.

questions.prompt: Why is the Italian restaurant a good idea today?
options: Pizzas are half price on Tuesdays.
questions.feedback: Salı günleri pizzalar yarı fiyat; bugün salı.
questions.evidence: on Tuesdays all pizzas are half price.

questions.prompt: What time are they going to eat?
questions.feedback: Max sekizi önerir ama Ella için geç; yedi buçukta (half past seven) anlaşıyorlar.
